title: projects.board.task.created
description: A card was added to a project's board. `assignee_id` is a delivery member id and is the column projects' OWN scope compares with the caller's subject reference. `completed_at` is non-null only for a card created directly in `done`.
$comment: Ahead of the producer (ADR-0020 slice I6): services/projects/app/services.py:create_task does not emit title, assignee_id, priority, due_date, points, completed_at yet.
